decisions.reason: As a newly highlighted product line closely tied to the core practice software, the digital anamnesis and consent app fits the firm's push toward digital, connected workflows in dental practices.
The continuing education institute builds on the firm's existing training and customer support strengths and can deepen client loyalty while complementing the software business.
A remote screen sharing support tool directly strengthens software implementation and service efficiency for dental practices, making it a practical extension of the established offer.
